Session 13 / Reinforcement learning

Policy gradients and actor-critic methods

Direct policy optimization, REINFORCE, variance reduction and actor-critic methods.

Planned date Dec 15, 2026

Learning objectives

  • Explain how a stochastic policy can be optimized directly.
  • Interpret a policy-gradient estimate and the role of a baseline.
  • Distinguish the actor and critic in an actor-critic method.

Before class

Sutton and Barto, Chapter 13; Stanford CS224R policy-gradient lectures.
